# axiz-core-messaging-sqs

Amazon SQS publisher and consumer adapter (standard and FIFO).

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-messaging-sqs</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `SqsEnvelopes` | Maps SQS messages (including SNS-delivered raw messages) to envelopes. |
| `SqsEventPublisher` | Publishes CloudEvents (structured JSON) to Amazon SQS. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-messaging-sqs verify`.
